name: local-inference
tagline: Run AI on Your Own Hardware
description: Connect QuoxCORE to self-hosted LLM inference servers running on your own GPU machines. Supports Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, and NVIDIA NIM via OpenAI-compatible APIs. Zero API costs, full data privacy, and complete audit trails for every inference request.
shortDescription: Self-hosted LLM inference with full auditability.
author: QUOX
betaMessage: Free during public beta. All features unlocked.
marketingPoints: Connect to Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, or NVIDIA NIM in minutes
Zero marginal API cost for every inference request
Your data never leaves your network
Auto-detect backend type and available models
Full AEE/VOLT audit trail for every local inference call

supportedBackends.name: Ollama
supportedBackends.notes: Easiest setup. Best for workstations and hobbyist use.

supportedBackends.name: vLLM
supportedBackends.notes: High-performance serving. Best for multi-user and enterprise.

supportedBackends.name: llama.cpp
supportedBackends.notes: Lightweight and flexible. Good for experimental setups.

supportedBackends.name: NVIDIA NIM
supportedBackends.notes: Enterprise-grade NVIDIA microservice. Best for data centres.

connection.name: Inference Server Connection
connection.description: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible inference server. Auto-detects whether you are running Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, or NVIDIA NIM.

modelSwitching.name: Model Switching
modelSwitching.description: Switch between locally available models mid-conversation. Load a fast 7B for quick queries, switch to 70B for complex reasoning.

streaming.name: Streaming Responses
streaming.description: Full SSE streaming support. Tokens appear in real-time, identical to cloud provider experience.

embeddings.name: Local Embeddings
embeddings.description: Generate embeddings locally for memory search and RAG pipelines. Your embedding data stays on your hardware.

healthChecks.name: Health Monitoring
healthChecks.description: Automatic health checks on configured sources. See connection status, model availability, and response latency at a glance.

usageMetrics.name: Usage Metrics
usageMetrics.description: Track token usage, latency, and request counts per model and source. Know exactly how your local compute is being used.

gpuAgent.name: GPU Fleet Agent
gpuAgent.description: Install QuoxAgent on GPU machines for automatic hardware discovery, VRAM monitoring, model enumeration, and fleet registration.

multiNode.name: Multi-Node Routing
multiNode.description: Route inference requests across multiple GPU nodes based on model availability, load, VRAM, and latency.

failover.name: Local-to-Cloud Failover
failover.description: Automatic fallback to cloud providers when local nodes are overloaded or unavailable. Configurable per source.

allowlists.name: Model Allowlists
allowlists.description: Restrict which models can be used per org or team. Enforce approved model lists for compliance.

auditTrail.name: Inference Audit Trail
auditTrail.description: Every local inference request produces an AEE envelope with provider, host, model, backend, privacy boundary, and timing metadata. Recorded in VOLT for tamper-evident audit.

residencyTags.name: Data Residency Tags
residencyTags.description: Tag each inference source with residency metadata (local, on-prem, EU, custom). Enforce data sovereignty policies per workflow.

name.label: Source Name
name.description: A friendly name for this inference source (e.g. 'Office GPU', 'ML Cluster')

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.description: The HTTP endpoint for the inference server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:11434)

authToken.label: API Key / Auth Token
authToken.description: Optional authentication token. Required if the inference server has auth enabled.

backendType.label: Backend Type
backendType.description: The inference runtime. Auto-detect will probe endpoints to determine the type.

defaultChatModel.label: Default Chat Model
defaultChatModel.description: Model to use for chat requests. Populated after connection test.

defaultEmbeddingModel.label: Default Embedding Model
defaultEmbeddingModel.description: Model to use for embeddings. Leave empty to disable local embeddings.

maxConcurrency.label: Max Concurrent Requests
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous inference requests to this source.

allowExternalFallback.label: Allow Cloud Fallback
allowExternalFallback.description: Fall back to a cloud provider if this source is unavailable.

healthCheckInterval.label: Health Check Interval (seconds)
healthCheckInterval.description: How often to check source availability.

requestTimeout.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
requestTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for an inference response. Increase for large models.

testimonials.quote: We run Llama 3 on our own hardware and Quox treats it exactly like any other provider. The audit trail is the same whether inference is local or cloud.
testimonials.author: Infrastructure Lead, Fintech Startup

testimonials.quote: Connected our vLLM cluster in about five minutes. The auto-detection just worked.
testimonials.author: ML Engineer
